mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate level compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. This relationship holds across all monetary regimes as the rate is a direct input to the discount rate.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns show a negative or insignificant correlation with FEDFUNDS level (Rank IC < 0.03) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPIAUCSL increase exceeding 0.5% signals accelerating inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten policy and reduce equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where CPIAUCSL monthly change exceeds 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer spending, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days. The effect is not captured by either series alone.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in less than 55% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS increase by at least 0.5% in the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: In a tight labor market (UNRATE < 4.0% and PAYEMS monthly change > 100), wage pressures intensify, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy and reduce equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where UNRATE < 4.0% and PAYEMS monthly change > 100.

mechanism_narrative: A higher industrial production level (INDPRO) indicates robust manufacturing activity, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days. This relationship holds across all supply regimes as production directly impacts corporate revenue.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns show a negative or insignificant correlation with INDPRO level (Rank IC < 0.03) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1200 thousand units signals weakening consumer demand, reducing corporate revenue expectations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where HOUST < 1200.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising inflation (CPIAUCSL) and a stable or rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an active monetary tightening cycle, compressing equity valuations and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. The effect is not captured by either series alone.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where CPIAUCSL increases by more than 0.5% and FEDFUNDS is above 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion (GDPC1 annualized growth exceeding 2.0% in the most recent quarter), economic momentum peaks, increasing recession risk and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where GDPC1 annualized growth exceeds 2.0%.
